title: Enrollment Status Page does not track provisioning progress

report.title: {Items.Count} Enrollment Status Page {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile does', 'profiles do')} not hold the device until provisioning completes

messages.businessImpact: Users reach the desktop before applications and policies have arrived, so a device that is not ready looks ready. The support calls that follow are indistinguishable from real faults.
remediation: Enable Show app and profile configuration progress.
Block device use until required apps are installed, listing only the applications genuinely needed on day one.
messages.cannotSee: The console's Block device use until all apps and profiles are installed has no property in Graph that this tool has identified, so a page that tracks progress is taken to hold the device, which is what Intune does. A tenant that has somehow tracked progress without blocking is therefore not reported here. Whether the applications the page waits for are the right ones is ENR-004's question, not this one.
